justification: Inspected `javaparser-core/src/main/java/com/github/javaparser/resolution/types/*.java`: there are 11 exact-package classes/interfaces with 1992 total LOC, and the package is a cohesive `ResolvedType` hierarchy (`ResolvedType`, `ResolvedReferenceType`, `ResolvedPrimitiveType`, `ResolvedArrayType`, `ResolvedTypeVariable`, `ResolvedWildcard`, `ResolvedUnionType`, `ResolvedIntersectionType`, `ResolvedVoidType`, `ResolvedLambdaConstraintType`, `ResolvedTypeTransformer`) focused on type representation and assignability. The largest file is `ResolvedReferenceType.java` at 652 LOC, but the responsibilities remain tightly centered on one concept rather than a broadly decomposable package-level God Component.
